changes: First library release for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, on core-ar2 0.7. Hold FIX and turn a knob to link that parameter to velocity, or SAMPLER for aftertouch, in the sound's own four velocity and four aftertouch mod slots; linked knobs show their amounts as performance locks do while the key is held.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
